text:
[LSTO.8.1.1] Series aggregations (`mean(s)`, `p95(s)`, etc. — see
[LSER]) operate over the live
backing structures in working memory, **not** the
samples plane. The samples plane is the durable
write-through; aggregations stay in-memory for bounded
cost and predictable latency. Backing-structure choice
is compiler-driven from the observation triples per
[LSER.18.1];
the samples plane is independent of that choice.
